answer: Salander was trapped in the abandoned brickworks with Niedermann and fought him, using a crowbar and crates to keep him at bay. She eventually pried open a padlock with an iron rod and escaped, leaving a knife behind [E1] [E2]. She then directed Nieminen’s gang to the brickworks and alerted the police; Niedermann was later reported killed by the gang [E3] [E4] [E5].
